<mxfile host="Electron" agent="supply-chain-scanner"> <diagram id="flow-npm" name="5. npm Two-Gate Flow"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1600" pageHeight="1500" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=22;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#1a1a1a;" value="npm Two-Gate Flow" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="800" x="40" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="subtitle" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontColor=#666666;" value="npm has no cargo-vet-shaped fast path. A version reaches a forwarded packument only if it is CVE-clean, past the release-age threshold (or allowlisted), and AI-review-passed. There is no substitute for the review step." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="1480" x="40" y="58" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ph1" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#d79b00;strokeWidth=2;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=8;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="350" width="1200" x="40" y="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ph1_t" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#9c5a00;" value="PHASE 1 — the packument. `GET /<name>`, or `/@scope%2fname` for a scoped package." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="26" width="900" x="54" y="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="n1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="npm resolves
(install / view)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="180" x="60" y="150" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="n2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="npm_packument_handler
validate_name FIRST (400 before upstream)
then NpmScanner::decide_packument" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="300" x="270" y="140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="n3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=10;align=center;fontStyle=1;" value="fetch the FULL packument
never the abbreviated form:
the age gate needs the `time` map" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="270" x="600" y="140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="n4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="over-size or unparseable
→ error, never a partial document" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="280" x="900" y="140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="n4n" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=9;fontColor=#9c2b25;" value="A truncated parse would drop versions
indistinguishably from the gate removing
them, so it fails closed." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="300" x="900" y="215" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="casc" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#9673a6;strokeWidth=2;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=8;spacingTop=4;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="930" x="270" y="240" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="casc_t" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#9673a6;" value="the newest-per-major cascade — eager filtering of the whole version list on every request" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="700" x="280" y="246" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cg1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=9;align=center;" value="CVE filter
(OSV npm feed)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="72" width="130" x="284" y="274" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cg2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=9;align=center;" value="release age
from the time map
(best effort)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="72" width="130" x="424" y="274" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cg3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=9;align=center;" value="allowlist
override" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="72" width="110" x="564" y="274" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cg4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=9;align=center;fontStyle=1;" value="AI review
NO fast path, ever" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="72" width="150" x="684" y="274" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cg5" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=9;align=center;" value="group by caret semantics:
major > 0 → major
0.x → minor
0.0.x → patch" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="72" width="170" x="844" y="274" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cg6" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=9;align=center;" value="newest passing
version per line,
newest line first" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="72" width="150" x="1024" y="274" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="n5" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="filter_packument: prune versions to the survivors; rewrite every dist.tarball to {public_url}/{name}/-/{unscoped}-{version}.tgz; rebuild dist-tags so latest names a version that is actually present, or dist-tags is empty. Non-latest tags whose target vanished are dropped, not repointed." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="55" width="930" x="270" y="375" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="dep" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=10;fontColor=#7f6000;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="DEPRECATED VERSIONS ARE STILL CANDIDATES
npm installs deprecated versions routinely. Excluding them would break ordinary
resolution for no security gain, so nothing in this cascade filters on deprecation." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="190" x="60" y="245" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ph2" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#b85450;strokeWidth=2;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=8;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="330" width="1200" x="40" y="480" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ph2_t" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#9c2b25;" value="PHASE 2 — the tarball. `GET /<name>/-/<file>`" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="26" width="700" x="54" y="490" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="routed" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=2;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=10;fontColor=#1f4e79;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="ROUTE DISPATCH, NOT A ROUTE OF ITS OWN
The plan called for `/{*name}/-/{file}`. matchit, which axum 0.8 uses, rejects a catch-all
that is not the final path segment: 'Catch-all parameters are only allowed at the end of a route'.
The narrower `/{name}/-/{file}` conflicts with the existing `/{*path}`. So the tarball is
dispatched from the one catch-all: `looks_like_tarball(path)` recognizes it and hands off
before the path is treated as a package name. Externally identical, scoped names included." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="140" width="380" x="60" y="525" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="npm tarball request
(scoped: literal unencoded /)
filename must be exactly
{unscoped}-{version}.tgz" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="230" x="470" y="525" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=10;align=center;fontStyle=1;" value="METADATA APPROVAL FIRST
NpmScanner::approved_for_download" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="260" x="730" y="525" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=10;align=center;fontStyle=1;" value="NOT approved → 403 refusal
ZERO fetches, ZERO plugin runs,
never reviewed inline" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="260" x="730" y="605" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="download tarball, verify digest
(integrity sha512 → shasum sha1 fallback)
before ANY unpack" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="250" x="470" y="690" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d5" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="unpack → org plugins
deduped by digest, one run
per artifact under concurrency" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="250" x="740" y="690" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d6" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;align=center;fontStyle=1;" value="store Clean, mark plugin_checked,
cache, serve bytes" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="200" x="1010" y="690" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d3n" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;strokeWidth=2;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=10;fontColor=#9c2b25;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="THE CONSTRAINT
No tarball bytes are served for an artifact that has not
passed CVE, release age, AI review AND the plugins. Serving
an unapproved version on a plugin pass would substitute
one check for the other three." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="380" x="60" y="690" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="decisions" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=8;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="230" width="1200" x="40" y="850" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="decisions_t" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#7f6000;" value="npm-specific decisions that are easy to get wrong" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="26" width="700" x="54" y="858" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="dec1" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=10;fontColor=#9c2b25;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="WRITE AND AUTH ARE REFUSED
PUT, POST, PATCH and DELETE on any path answer 403 with a
sentence: this is a read-only gateway, so publish, login, token
and dist-tag are unsupported. Explicit rather than the router's
bare method-not-allowed answer, so an operator learns why
immediately instead of from a half-completed publish.
The two audit stubs keep their own POST routes." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="380" x="60" y="890" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="dec2" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=10;fontColor=#1f4e79;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="THE AUDIT ENDPOINTS ANSWER 404, LOCALLY
/-/npm/v1/security/advisories/bulk and /audits/quick are never
proxied. Forwarding either would ship the org's entire dependency
tree to the public registry on every install, which this proxy's
whole posture argues against. npm treats the 404 as 'no summary
available' and continues. The proxy's own CVE gate blocks rather
than reports, which is the stronger coverage for the same purpose." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="380" x="455" y="890" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="dec3" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=10;fontColor=#7f6000;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="A DEPLOYMENT WITHOUT [ai_review] REFUSES TO START
The check is config.ai_review(), so a present-but-disabled table is
refused exactly like an absent one: a disabled reviewer cannot review.
Startup logs error! naming that no version could ever be forwarded,
then bails. Serving a registry that can never answer is worse than a
clear startup failure.
/-/ping answers unconditionally and reads no state." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="380" x="850" y="890" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lockfile" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;strokeWidth=2;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=10;fontColor=#9c2b25;fontStyle=1;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="THE LOCKFILE DEFECT THE PROXY CANNOT FIX
A lockfile generated before the org adopted the proxy pins each `resolved` URL at the public registry, so `npm ci` fetches those tarballs directly and no gate applies. The proxy cannot intercept a request that is never sent to it. The fix is regenerating lockfiles behind the proxy. The converse is also true: a lockfile made behind the proxy carries internal URLs and does not work outside the network. tests/npm_lockfile.rs pins both directions." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="1200" x="40" y="1100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_n1_n2" edge="1" parent="1" source="n1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#d79b00;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;" target="n2"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_n2_n3" div.div: npm has no cargo-vet-shaped fast path. A version reaches a forwarded packument only if it is CVE-clean, past the release-age threshold (or allowlisted), and AI-review-passed. There is no substitute for the review step.

div.div:
ROUTE DISPATCH, NOT A ROUTE OF ITS OWN
The plan called for `/{*name}/-/{file}`. matchit, which axum 0.8 uses, rejects a catch-all
that is not the final path segment: 'Catch-all parameters are only allowed at the end of a route'.
The narrower `/{name}/-/{file}` conflicts with the existing `/{*path}`. So the tarball is
dispatched from the one catch-all: `looks_like_tarball(path)` recognizes it and hands off
before the path is treated as a package name. Externally identical, scoped names included.

div.div:
THE CONSTRAINT
No tarball bytes are served for an artifact that has not
passed CVE, release age, AI review AND the plugins. Serving
an unapproved version on a plugin pass would substitute
one check for the other three.

div.div: npm-specific decisions that are easy to get wrong

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(248, 206, 204), rgb(81, 45, 43)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(184, 84, 80), rgb(215, 129, 126));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 368px; height: 1px; padding-top: 883px; margin-left: 33px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #9c2b25;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#9c2b25, #ff9f9a); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
WRITE AND AUTH ARE REFUSED
PUT, POST, PATCH and DELETE on any path answer 403 with a
sentence: this is a read-only gateway, so publish, login, token
and dist-tag are unsupported. Explicit rather than the router's
bare method-not-allowed answer, so an operator learns why
immediately instead of from a half-completed publish.
The two audit stubs keep their own POST routes.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(218, 232, 252), rgb(29, 41, 59)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 368px; height: 1px; padding-top: 883px; margin-left: 428px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1f4e79;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#1f4e79, #8eb6db); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
THE AUDIT ENDPOINTS ANSWER 404, LOCALLY
/-/npm/v1/security/advisories/bulk and /audits/quick are never
proxied. Forwarding either would ship the org's entire dependency
tree to the public registry on every install, which this proxy's
whole posture argues against. npm treats the 404 as 'no summary
available' and continues. The proxy's own CVE gate blocks rather
than reports, which is the stronger coverage for the same purpose.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 368px; height: 1px; padding-top: 883px; margin-left: 823px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #7f6000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#7f6000, #b69b49); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
A DEPLOYMENT WITHOUT [ai_review] REFUSES TO START
The check is config.ai_review(), so a present-but-disabled table is
refused exactly like an absent one: a disabled reviewer cannot review.
Startup logs error! naming that no version could ever be forwarded,
then bails. Serving a registry that can never answer is worse than a
clear startup failure.
/-/ping answers unconditionally and reads no state.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(248, 206, 204), rgb(81, 45, 43)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(184, 84, 80), rgb(215, 129, 126));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1188px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1093px; margin-left: 13px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #9c2b25;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#9c2b25, #ff9f9a); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
THE LOCKFILE DEFECT THE PROXY CANNOT FIX
A lockfile generated before the org adopted the proxy pins each `resolved` URL at the public registry, so `npm ci` fetches those tarballs directly and no gate applies. The proxy cannot intercept a request that is never sent to it. The fix is regenerating lockfiles behind the proxy. The converse is also true: a lockfile made behind the proxy carries internal URLs and does not work outside the network. tests/npm_lockfile.rs pins both directions.
